title: 第二十三章 玉纹藏旧秘暗处现真机第二十四章 弃子绝生路暗潮覆京畿
lines: 翌日清晨，薄雾未散，庭院清宁。
沈清鸢一早便醒了，掌心始终攥着那枚墨玉吊坠。
昨夜彻夜细思，过往所有被忽略的细碎疑点，此刻尽数串联起来。
柳氏一介普通寒门女子，无家世无背景，初入相府便能稳稳立足，短短数年拿捏后宅权柄，勾结东宫、暗害主母、侵吞巨额嫁妆，步步狠绝、布局缜密，根本不是寻常后院妇人能有的眼界与手段。
她的背后，必然有人长期指点、暗中支撑。
春桃端着洗漱用具入内，见自家小姐对着一枚旧玉佩凝神沉思，轻声道：“小姐，要不咱们找张嬷嬷再问问？老奴是跟着主母最久的人，说不定能想起些遗漏的旧事。”
沈清鸢微微颔首。
不多时，张嬷嬷便匆匆赶来。
历经旧案昭雪，她心头大石落地，气色好了许多，只是提起旧主，眼底依旧带着敬畏与惋惜。
“嬷嬷，你仔细回想，母亲当年出嫁前后，是否曾佩戴过这枚墨玉吊坠？是否有陌生之人、特殊信物往来？”沈清鸢将玉佩递到她眼前。
张嬷嬷凑近细看，目光落在玉佩内侧隐秘的细纹上，瞳孔骤然一缩，脸色瞬间大变。
她颤巍巍伸出手，小心翼翼捧着玉佩，指尖死死摩挲纹路，眼眶瞬间泛红，声音发抖：“是……是这个纹路！老奴记起来了！”
“当年主母未出阁时，曾有一位蒙面老者上门拜访，留下一句‘护玉护身，逢乱避祸’，还叮嘱主母，此生不可轻易示人，更不可对外提及玉佩来历！”
“老奴当年年幼懵懂，只记得老者气质不凡，绝非寻常市井之人，且言语间隐隐带着江湖世家的气度。主母一生谨守叮嘱，从未对外说起半句，就连老爷，也从未知晓玉佩的隐秘！”
这番话，彻底印证了沈清鸢的猜测。
她的生母，从来就不是简简单单的书香文士之女。
看似平淡无波的身世之下，藏着不为人知的隐秘过往。
“那母亲当年病逝，柳氏步步紧逼夺玉，是不是也为了这个？”春桃忍不住出声追问。
张嬷嬷重重点头，咬牙道：“定然如此！柳氏这些年翻遍主母旧物，数次悄悄搜寻贴身配饰，老奴从前不解，如今才算明白，她要的不只是家产权柄，更是这枚玉佩！”
就在此时，院外暗卫快步入内，神色凝重跪地禀报。
“大小姐，最新消息！柳氏流放队伍行至盘山驿道，昨夜再次遭遇黑衣人窥探。对方全程隐匿身形，不劫人、不伤人，只是暗中观察看守兵力，且在营地外留下一枚特殊青铜纹符，随后尽数撤离。”
“驿卒辨认，那纹符是多年前绝迹的暗阁信物！”
暗阁二字落下，沈清鸢眸色骤然深沉。
她前世纵横浮沉，隐约听过这个名字。
暗阁，游离于朝堂与江湖之间的隐秘势力，行事诡秘、蛰伏百年，从不轻易入世，却能暗中搅动各方棋局，扶持棋子、操纵纷争，无人知晓其阁主真身，无人摸清其真正目的。
原来，这就是藏在所有风波背后的真正黑手。
柳氏是暗阁安插在相府的棋子，数十年蛰伏，只为夺取生母手中的墨玉玉佩。
十几年谋害、侵吞、构陷，从来不是单纯的后宅妒恨，而是一场谋划数十年的夺宝布局。
细思极恐。
若不是她今生重生归来，步步破局，任由柳氏得逞，玉佩落入暗阁手中，后果不堪设想。
正当院内气氛沉凝之时，府门小厮来报，摄政王府车马到访。
content_en:
The next morning, the mist had not dispersed, and the courtyard was quiet and peaceful.
Shen Qingyuan woke up early in the morning, always holding the ink jade pendant in his palm.
I thought about it all night long, and all the little doubts that had been ignored in the past were connected together at this moment.
The Liu family was an ordinary woman from a poor family, with no family background and no background. She was able to establish herself firmly when she first entered the prime minister's palace. In just a few years, she controlled the power of the queen's house, colluded with the East Palace, assassinated the mistress, and embezzled a huge dowry. Her every step was ruthless and meticulous. She was not the vision and means that ordinary women in the backyard could have.
Behind her, there must be someone who has long-term guidance and secret support.
Chuntao entered with the toiletries in hand and saw her young lady contemplating an old jade pendant. She said softly: "Miss, why don't we ask Aunt Zhang for more questions? This old slave is the one who has been with the mistress for the longest time. Maybe he can remember some forgotten old things."
Shen Qingyuan nodded slightly.
Not long after, Grandma Zhang hurried over.
After the old case came to light, she was devastated and looked much better. But when she mentioned her old master, there was still awe and regret in her eyes.
"Mommy, think carefully, did your mother wear this black jade pendant before and after she got married? Did she have any contact with strangers or special tokens?" Shen Qingyuan handed the jade pendant to her.
Nanny Zhang took a closer look, her eyes fell on the hidden fine lines on the inside of the jade pendant, her pupils suddenly shrank, and her expression suddenly changed.
She stretched out her hand tremblingly, holding the jade pendant carefully, rubbing the lines with her fingertips, her eyes instantly turned red, and her voice trembled: "Yes... it's this pattern! I remember it!"
"Back when the mistress was not out of the palace, a masked old man came to visit and left a message, 'Protect the jade to protect yourself and avoid trouble in times of trouble.' He also told the mistress not to reveal it to others easily in this life, let alone mention the origin of the jade pendant to others!"
"The old slave was young and ignorant back then. He only remembers that the old man had an extraordinary temperament. He was definitely not an ordinary person in the market, and his words were vaguely bearing the bearing of an aristocratic family. The mistress has always adhered to her instructions throughout her life and has never said a word to anyone. Even the master has never known the secret of the jade pendant!"
These words completely confirmed Shen Qingyuan's guess.
Her biological mother had never been a simple daughter of a scholarly scholar.
Beneath the seemingly ordinary life experience, there is a secret past that is unknown to everyone.
"Then my mother died of illness that year, and Mrs. Liu pressed hard to seize the jade. Was it because of this?" Chuntao couldn't help but ask.
Nanny Zhang nodded heavily and gritted her teeth and said, "It must be so! Ms. Liu has gone through her mistress's old belongings over the years and secretly searched for personal accessories several times. The old slave was puzzled before, but now she finally understands that she wants not only the family property and power, but also this jade pendant!"
At this moment, the secret guard outside the courtyard quickly walked in, and he knelt down with a solemn expression to report.
"Miss, the latest news! The Liu family's exile team was traveling to the Panshan Post Road and was spied on by a man in black again last night. The man hid his body throughout the whole process and did not rob or hurt anyone. He only secretly observed the guards and left a special bronze talisman outside the camp, and then all of them evacuated."
"The postman identified it and found that the talisman was a secret token from the secret pavilion that disappeared many years ago!"
When the word "Ange" fell, Shen Qingyuan's eyes suddenly darkened.
She had experienced ups and downs in her previous life, and had vaguely heard of this name.
The Dark Pavilion is a secret force that wanders between the court and the world. It acts secretly and has been dormant for hundreds of years. It never enters the world easily, but it can secretly disturb the chess game of all parties, support the chess pieces, and manipulate disputes. No one knows the true identity of its master, and no one can figure out its true purpose.
It turns out that this is the real black hand behind all the troubles.
Mrs. Liu is a chess piece placed by the Ange in the Prime Minister's Mansion. She has been dormant for decades, just to seize the black jade pendant from her biological mother.
The more than ten years of murder, embezzlement, and frame-up were never simply jealousy, but a treasure-hunting plan that had been planned for decades.
It's scary to think about it.
If she hadn't come back again in this life, broken the situation step by step, and allowed Liu to succeed, the jade pendant would have fallen into the hands of Ange, and the consequences would have been disastrous.
Just when the atmosphere in the courtyard was calm, the servant at the palace gate came to report that the regent's palace had arrived with carriages and horses.
title_en: Chapter 23: The old secret hidden in the jade pattern reveals the real machine Chapter 24: The abandoned son is destined to die and the undercurrent overturns Gyeonggi
